finding: Slovak firms face margin compression as input costs outpace selling prices
bullets: Slovak firms (n=224) expected production input prices to rise 7.33% over the next 12 months, far exceeding selling price expectations of 3.75% (n=222), pointing to sustained margin compression.
Slovak wage expectations held at 4.12% (n=233), easing only 0.09 pp from wave 38, and ran 1.52 pp above the euro area's 2.60%, reinforcing the cost-side squeeze.
Five-year inflation expectations among Slovak firms stood at 7.66% (n=165), declining 0.91 pp from wave 38 but remaining 1.72 pp above the EA average of 5.94%.
chart_subtitle: Slovak firms expect input prices to rise 7.33% in 12 months.
